glosses: to wipe (to remove dirt or moisture from the surface by gently running something over it) [with instrumental ‘with what’]
to fray (to cause deterioration on the surface due to frequent use)
to purée (to transform into a uniform mass by pressing through the holes of a sieve)
to rub (to press against something, i.e. one's eyes)
to cut through (to overcome the difficulties of the terrain, making it easier for others to navigate it)
to cut through, to blaze (to make easier for others by doing something furst) [with dative] or
to enculture (to give refinement or polish)
The meaning of this term is uncertain.
